source: Cluster run (Ubuntu 22.04, g++ 12.3, glibc 2.35, Intel Xeon), FlapSim commit deab6c8. Summary only; the per-episode rows of the cluster runs are not included in this repository. Compare only within the cluster. Arm values are test qualities on the 72-episode protocol.
set: ES-refinement pilot, 72-episode protocol, 600 s training, ES seeds 0/1/2 (seed 0 = original hardcoded seed)
criterion: S2: beat frozen s1 by +0.005 with crashes <= frozen

phase2_3600s.caveat: MAX_GENS hardcoded (C1 6, C2/full/no-gate 5, C3 3), PAIRS=4: stopped after 780-840 s; not a budget test

summary.es_runs_detail: phase 1: 15 = C1, C2, C3, full_es, no_gate x seeds 0/1/2; phase 2: 4 = C2, C3 x seeds 0/1 at 3600 s
summary.gate_accepted: 9 of 16 gated ES runs (C1 3/3, C2 4/5, C3 2/5, full_es 0/3)
summary.accepted_changes: all tied or hurt; 3 introduced a nominal crash (frozen s1 has none)

configs.C1: CRN antithetic ES on the readout subspace (W_out, b_o, W_g, b_g; ~360 params)
configs.C2: <=14-dim excitability subspace (b_h, b_o, b_g, log-gains) with a paired gate
configs.C3: uncapped log-score fitness on mined hit-frontier cases, same subspace as C2

naming: probe = classical + pulse law (the classical controller with its pulse law kept on during manoeuvres, ablate14.ClassicalUnsuppressed); rule = the same arm in P5; snn_s<k> = snn11_s<k>; ppo_s<k> = mlp_ppo_s<k>
